# trustset

> An off switch for AI agents, on chain. An agent has a key it signs with;
> trustset gives its owner a separate cold key that can stop it, and gives
> every app the agent talks to one call to check before acting.

Built by Silk Nodes for Monad Metropolis, track 04. Live at
https://trustset.silknodes.io

## What it is

Eight primitives, each its own immutable contract with no admin and no owner:
the switch, a passkey panic button, guardians, time limits, past signatures,
identity, human proof, and refunds. An app picks what it needs. There is no
platform to join, no account, no allowlist and no fee beyond gas.

One transaction from a cold key writes a new status, and from the next block
`isTrusted(agentId)` returns false to everyone who asks. Pausing is
reversible. Stopping for good is not.

## Checking an agent

```
npx @trustset/check 7
npx @trustset/check --erc8004 41
```

In an app: `npm i @trustset/check`, or call `isTrusted(uint256)` directly on
the switch. Reading is a view call and costs the caller nothing.

## Deployed, Monad testnet only (chain id 10143)

- KillSwitch          0x54D8211233Cc65b62C594cBAb900930dd37ED3b8
- AgentLabels         0x1fc5CF0a5bD938cc36EcE4ca34F2279e0e5b5f0f
- HumanTouch          0x059563eb1dC1BBd7a8261309E92063A3f41AAda0
- RefundRail          0xf8E44F08263fFB04660483Af44b70E1b25347748
- ERC-8004 identity   0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e  (not ours)

Immutable values, fixed at deployment: cold key change 24 hours, guardian
escalation 10 minutes, guardian recovery 10 minutes.

## What is true, and what is not

- Nobody can change the contracts, including their authors. No owner address
  exists in the source, and there is no proxy, initialize, delegatecall or
  selfdestruct. A fix means a new contract deployed beside the old one.
- The KillSwitch holds no funds. A bug there produces a wrong status, never a
  lost coin. Only the refund rail holds money, and it only ever returns it to
  the payer named in storage.
- No server of ours sits in any path.
- An agent key can only be registered by whoever holds it: registration needs
  that key's signature naming the exact cold key.
- A stop does NOT protect against an agent that has been taken over and
  rewritten. A compromised agent holding a valid key passes every check.
- A stop does nothing at a venue that never checks.
- It is NOT audited by a third party. 141 tests and eleven invariants across
  128,000 fuzzed calls per run, self reviewed, written up in AUDIT.md.
- Testnet only. Never deployed to mainnet. No real money is at stake.
